A RESOLUTION TO UPDATE THE HALL COUNTY LOCAL OPERATIONS AND EMERGENCY MANAGEMENT PLAN NO: 82-2026-11-01

WHEREAS, the Board of Commissioners of Hall County, Georgia (the “Board’) established the Hall County Emergency Management Agency (“Emergency Management”) on December 13, 1982 to allow for coordinated and effective responses by the County and Cities within the County to disasters that endanger citizens’ lives and property; and

WHEREAS, 0.C.G.A. § 38-3-27 and 0.C.G.A. § 38-3-28 authorize the Board and the governing authorities of each City within the County to effectuate contracts, orders, rules, and regulations as may be necessary for emergency management purposes, so long as their actions comply with State and Federal law; and

WHEREAS, the Board enacted an ordinance in Chapter 2.70 of the Official Code of Hall County, Georgia to provide for the supervision of the Emergency Management Agency Director; and

WHEREAS, the Emergency Management Agency Director is charged with developing the Local Emergency Operations Plan, which must be consistent with the Georgia Emergency Operations Plan; and

WHEREAS, in addition to maintaining the Georgia Emergency Operations Plan, the Georgia Emergency Management and Homeland Security Agency (GEMA/HS) is the state agency assigned responsibility for the coordination of all organization for emergency management activities with the State; and

WHEREAS, Hall County’s Local Emergency Operations Plan needs to be updated to comply and GEMA/HS requirements, ongoing planning efforts, and lessons learned from real world experiences; and

WHEREAS, in accordance with O.C.G.A. § 38-3-1 et seq. and Chapter 2.70 of the Official Code of Hall County, Georgia, the Board and the governing authorities of the municipalities located within Hall County must approve the Local Emergency Operations Plan before it can be submitted to GEMA/HS.

NOW, THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLVED by the Town Council of Clermont, Georgia, as follows:

1.

The Local Emergency Operations Plan as prepared by the Hall County Emergency Management Agency is hereby approved and adopted as set forth in “Exhibit A,” a copy of which is attached hereto and made a part hereof as if it were originally set forth in this resolution.

2.

All Resolutions, or Ordinances, or parts thereof, related to the Local Operations Emergency

Plan previously adopted by the Clermont Town Council, and in conflict with the terms of this Resolution, are repealed.

3.

The Clermont Town Council authorizes James Nix, in his capacity as Clermont Mayor, to execute all documentation and make communications necessary to have the Local Operations Management Plan approved by GEMA/HS.

This Resolution is hereby adopted this. ) day of November, 2026, to become effective upon the A day of November, 2026, the public health, safety, and general welfare demanding it.

SO RESOLVED, this the 5S day of November, 2026.
